key_concepts: Natural things are found in nature and exist without human intervention.
Human-made things are created by people using natural materials or other resources.
Living things grow, move, respond, reproduce, and need food, water, and air.
Non-living things do not grow, move, respond, reproduce, or need food, water, and air.
